description: This is a comprehensive Python module for subtitle correction, alignment, and OTT constraints enforcement. It includes functions for normalizing text, detecting language mismatches, matching subtitle cues with transcript segments, semantic and fuzzy matching, temporal adjustments, and optional audio embedding-based disambiguation. The module facilitates accurate subtitle timing, text correction, missing cue generation, and final OTT compliance, suitable for integration into subtitle post-processing pipelines.
